external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A company that subscribes to and uses the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice link and views the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console to open billing-app sessions as customer users.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used by customer users to manage invoices and request PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the billing app checks that the invoice belongs to the user's company. Nobody wrote down whether the billing app checks the user's role again when a request arrives.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console used by support agents to open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself, and the database has no row-level security. Nobody recorded how the billing app and the renderer reach the database, or how the database is protected at rest.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue holding PDF render jobs containing a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket storing rendered PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: one PDF bucket in our cloud platform
data_stores.notes: Nobody recorded how the billing app and the renderer reach the bucket, or how the bucket is protected at rest.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A customer user signs in to the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: Email address, password, and session cookie

data_flows.name: open invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user opens an invoice in the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a user opens an invoice, the billing app loads it by its invoice number.
data_flows.notes: Nobody wrote down whether it also checks that the invoice belongs to the user's company.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice number and invoice contents

data_flows.name: edit invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user submits an invoice edit to the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The invoice edit form posts the whole invoice back
data_flows.notes: The billing app saves every field it receives, including the paid flag and the company's payout bank account.
data_flows.data_description: Whole invoice, including paid flag and payout bank account

data_flows.name: request PDF
data_flows.description: A customer user requests a PDF of an invoice.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Any user can ask for a PDF of any invoice, as often as they like.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice number and PDF request

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice link to the payer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link ending in the invoice number

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows the invoice link to view the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: It asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: query tenant database
data_flows.description: The billing app queries the tenant database for invoice and customer records and saves invoice changes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account shared across companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, and invoice updates

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app puts a PDF render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.notes: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes a render job from the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.notes: Nobody recorded how the renderer reaches the queue.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: Nobody recorded how the renderer reaches the database.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice identified by company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.notes: It trusts the company ID the job carries. Nobody recorded how the renderer reaches the bucket.
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: One service credential is used for all companies. Nobody recorded how the billing app reaches the bucket.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential shared across companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Support agent account and one-time code

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Everything the agent then does is recorded in the tenant database against that customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session and subsequent customer-user actions

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: The tenant boundary associated with each customer company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The shared cloud platform hosting the billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents can reach the admin console.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database is confidential because it contains invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket is confidential because it stores rendered invoice PDFs containing the system's business and financial records.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the renderer reads invoices and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
